label: The brief is 240-296 characters (about 60-74 tokens) and 79 to 90 percent of a short brief is the same static directive block.
The head uses 72 to 96 of its 320 available characters, leaving about 225 characters unused on every prompt.
The brief names a command but never its document path, and the 13 create commands have no Skill-tool route while .claude/commands/create/skill.md exists.
The closed diagnostic schema records skillLabel and emittedBytes but no offered command or policy, so an offer cannot be distinguished from a decline.
An argued doctor route such as /doctor:git hooks can never be scored from its document read because commandParts keeps the argument in the name.
